title: Firmware update
intro: Choose a firmware file (.bin) for your device.
bleUnsupported: Bluetooth is unavailable in this browser. Try the desktop app.
usbUnsupported: USB is unavailable in this browser. Try the desktop app.
recoveryHelp: Put the device in USB recovery mode, then connect it. Recovery may overwrite the current firmware. Keep USB connected until it finishes.
recoveryReady: The device is in USB recovery mode.
ready: Choose a firmware file and connect to begin.
paused: Upload paused. Reconnect if needed, then continue.
uploaded: Firmware uploaded. Restart to try the new version.
awaitingReconnect: Wait for the device to restart, then reconnect to check the update.
unconfirmed: New firmware is running and awaiting confirmation. Check that the device works correctly before confirming. It may revert on restart until confirmed.
recovered: Firmware written. Restart the device and check that it starts normally.
recoveryRestarted: Restart requested. Check that the device starts normally.
reverted: The previous firmware is running again. The selected update was not activated or was rolled back.
unknown: The selected firmware is not running. Check the device and refresh its firmware status.
invalidFile: Choose a valid firmware .bin file within the size limit.
unsupportedImage: This firmware format is not supported. Choose an update .bin file for this device.
hashMismatch: The firmware file failed its integrity check. Obtain a fresh copy of the file.
uploadStalled: The upload has stopped progressing. Reconnect and try again.
uploadMismatch: Could not verify the uploaded firmware. Check the device status before continuing.
unconfirmedImage: The currently running firmware is not confirmed. Complete its test and confirmation before uploading another image.
protocol: Could not read the device response. Reconnect and try again.
timeout: The device did not respond in time. Reconnect to check its status or resume the upload.
endTaskHelp: End this task? Uploaded firmware stays on the device. An unconfirmed version may revert on restart.
bootTimeout: The device has not reconnected yet. Continue waiting or reconnect to check the update.
waitingBoot: Waiting for the device to finish the update and start…
